// @provenance rule: rule_class
export class Token {}

// @provenance rule: rule_interface
export interface Shape {
  area(): number;
}

// @provenance rule: rule_alias
export type Hours = number;

// @provenance rule: rule_default_class
export default class Ledger {
  // @provenance rule: rule_decorated_method
  @memoize()
  public async total(): Promise<number> {
    return 0;
  }

  // @provenance rule: rule_arrow_property
  total = () => {
    return 1;
  };
}

// @provenance verification: examples
// @provenance rule: rule_describe
describe("payroll", () => {
  it("pays", () => {});
});

// @provenance rule: rule_async_function
export async function paysOvertime(hours: number): Promise<boolean> {
  return hours > 38;
}

// @provenance rule: rule_const_enum
export const enum Shift {
  Day,
}

// @provenance rule: rule_abstract_class
export abstract class Base {}

export class Clock {
  // @provenance rule: rule_generator_method
  *shifts() {
    const first = 1;
    yield first;
  }

  // @provenance rule: rule_getter
  get total(): number {
    return 0;
  }

  // @provenance rule: rule_setter
  set total(value: number) {}

  // @provenance rule: rule_optional_method
  pays?(hours: number): boolean;

  // @provenance rule: rule_parameter_properties
  constructor(
    private readonly first: number,
    private readonly second: number,
    private readonly third: number,
    private readonly fourth: number,
    private readonly fifth: number,
  ) {}

  run(): void {
    // @provenance rule: rule_ternary
    ready ? (start) : stop;
    // @provenance rule: rule_call_then_block
    start(1)
    {
      stop();
    }
  }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_internal_doc
/** @internal */ export function hidden(): void {}
export function visible(): void {}

// @provenance rule: rule_export_decorated
export @sealed class Sealed {}

// @provenance rule: rule_default_decorated
export default @sealed class SealedDefault {}
